title: Wonderwall
hook: The *two notes* that never move in Wonderwall

chords.name: F#m7
chords.text: Capo 2. The top two notes, *E and A*, ring all song.

chords.name: A
chords.text: The bass and one voice move. *The drone stays*.

chords.name: Esus4
chords.text: Sus4: no third, so *neither major nor minor*.

chords.name: B7sus4
chords.text: Still suspended. It *never lands*, so it loops.

chords.name: F#m7
chords.text: Same two notes on top, *start to finish*.
